readFrom: on-screen coordinate readout (bottom-left of the frame), which is the game's own number for where the player was standing
measuredBy: The reference image is that same frame; the builder crops the minimap at runtime geometry (--reference-full-snapshot) and requires the features to localize it within 8 map pixels of this coordinate.
note: The anchor is an observation, not a target. It is the first of the four calibration captures because that frame happens to be a normal gameplay frame with a clean minimap; no extra walking was needed. The registry uses this instead of the derived window centre.
